theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is the highest-ranked ELIGIBLE trend in the detector with near-total breadth (0.955) and a mid-range durability bar (0.69), suggesting the trend is broad but not yet exhausted. The absolute-trend gate (the one validated edge) grants eligibility, which supports holding the theme as trend-following exposure rather than as an alpha call. Crowding (z=1.03, crowded=true) is a size-down caution, not a reason to fade or sell.
